laws.rule: Hortobágy Wildlife Park (reached only by the national park's vehicle from Hortobágy): adult 2,500 Ft, child/student/pensioner 2,000 Ft, family 7,300 Ft; safari extra 2,700 Ft. Closed Mondays, 1 November 2026 and 21 December 2026 to 4 January 2027. (No RBA rate for HUF; at the Magyar Nemzeti Bank rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 229.66 HUF: 2,500 Ft ≈ A$10.89; 7,300 Ft ≈ A$31.79; 2,700 Ft ≈ A$11.76)
